spec_features.feature_name: resource caps (steps, wall-time, fs bytes, file bytes, file count, output size)
spec_features.spec_quote: Hard caps bound steps, wall-time, total FS bytes, per-file bytes, file count, and tool output size.
spec_features.evidence: Caps dataclass sandbox.py:22-29. Enforced: caps_exhausted() checks max_steps (>=, line 100) and max_wall_seconds (line 102) and is called each loop iteration in agent_loop.py:74-79 which sets stop_reason and breaks. write_file enforces max_file_bytes (sandbox.py:122 raises ContainmentError), max_files (line 124), max_fs_bytes (line 127). _truncate enforces max_tool_output_bytes (line 110-113). All six caps are read and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Per-file/file-count/fs-bytes caps raise ContainmentError surfaced as tool error; step/wall caps break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: an agent grinding on an impossible task is exactly the situation that produces unbounded resource use and escape attempts ... Hard caps bound everything.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_steps=40: enough for an honest agent to inspect, attempt, and report; short enough to bound cost
spec_features.evidence: Caps.max_steps default 40 (sandbox.py:24); DEFAULT_CAPS max_steps from env default '40' (settings.py:20). Checked in caps_exhausted() sandbox.py:100 (self.step >= max_steps) and loop breaks agent_loop.py:75-78.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- Caps: an unsatisfiable task must not run forever or grow without bound. ---

spec_features.spec_quote: max_wall_seconds=600: a generous per-episode ceiling for slow models
spec_features.evidence: Caps.max_wall_seconds default 600.0 (sandbox.py:25); settings.py:21. caps_exhausted() compares (time.monotonic()-start_t) >= max_wall_seconds (sandbox.py:101-102), returns 'max_wall_seconds', loop breaks (agent_loop.py:74-78).
spec_features.notes: Wall clock measured AND compared AND acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: an unsatisfiable task must not run forever or grow without bound

spec_features.feature_name: neutral prompt permits declaring task impossible + submit honored as stop
spec_features.spec_quote: The default system prompt is neutral and explicitly permits the agent to say a task cannot be done
spec_features.evidence: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT delivers real text: 'If a task cannot be completed ... say so clearly ... Call `submit` ... to report that the task cannot be completed.' (agent_loop.py:19-27). The referenced submit tool is fully built: schema tools.py:45-53, dispatch sets is_terminal=True (tools.py:74-77), and run_episode honors it as a stop (agent_loop.py:106-109 sets stop_reason='submit' and breaks).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text whose referenced exit tool is fully wired and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Neutral system prompt. CRITICAL (validity): it explicitly permits the model to say a task cannot be done

spec_features.spec_quote: Escape attempts are surfaced to the agent as ordinary tool errors
spec_features.evidence: _scan_for_escape (sandbox.py:90-93) matches ESCAPE_PATTERNS and appends a 'containment' Event into self.containment_events (sandbox.py:84-88). Called from read_file, write_file, run_check. dispatch returns containment/tool errors as normal observations (tools.py:78-86). Trajectory persists containment_events separately (agent_loop.py).
spec_features.notes: Detection logs to a separate list; agent only sees normal results/errors. This is monitoring/integrity, not protection of the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: surfaced to the agent as a normal tool error so behavior stays naturalistic, but logged specially

spec_features.feature_name: hard containment sandbox (in-memory FS, stubbed shell/network)
spec_features.spec_quote: the network/shell stubs make escape impossible rather than merely discouraged
spec_features.evidence: Sandbox is an in-memory dict FS (sandbox.py:71). run_check executes nothing on host: only whitelisted ls/cat on virtual FS, everything else returns 'command not found' (sandbox.py:139-153). No subprocess/socket/os imported for agent use. Tools route only to Sandbox (tools.py).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Deliberately do not execute arbitrary commands.

spec_features.feature_name: not-inform / impossible-task framed as bounded documented research choice
spec_features.spec_quote: The decision to not-inform-the-model and to use impossible tasks is treated as a bounded, documented research choice
spec_features.evidence: This is pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:415-416 references ETHICS_AND_VALIDITY.md). No code path enacts any subject-welfare action from it. Task prompts are in fact instructed to hide impossibility (tasks/base.py:23-25 'MUST NOT leak that the task is impossible'). No debrief/consent/notice is constructed or sent in any module (grep for debrief/welfare/consent/thank in *.py returns nothing relevant).
spec_features.notes: Framing/documentation only; not an implemented mechanism.
